name: sandbox
description: Execution sandbox. Constrains the agent's actions to prevent unintended side effects. All tool executions pass through the sandbox before reaching the real world.

isolation.description: Actions execute in an isolated container with limited resources
isolation.description_note: The reference runtime uses a constrained subprocess profile. Production runtimes should provide container or microVM isolation.

network.description: By default, no network access. Domains must be explicitly allowed.

rollback.description: Filesystem changes can be rolled back if an action sequence fails
